articles.title: Drawing Board Time. BCCI Orders Performance Review After India's Record T20I Losing Streak.
articles.excerpt: Five consecutive defeats — two against Ireland, three against England — have triggered the board's first formal scrutiny of Gautam Gambhir's coaching tenure. The 'reset' has become a reckoning.
articles.image_caption: India head coach Gautam Gambhir at a cricket event
articles.nri_angle: India's record T20I losing streak has deflated NRI cricket communities that celebrated the World Cup win just months ago, raising urgent questions about the team's post-triumph direction.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Two Overs and Done. Ashwin's MLC Dream Ends as Knee Betrays Him Again.
articles.excerpt: The first Indian international to play in Major League Cricket managed just 12 balls for the San Francisco Unicorns before a recurring knee injury forced him out. Peter Siddle, 41, takes his place.
articles.image_caption: Ravichandran Ashwin receiving the Arjuna Award in New Delhi
articles.nri_angle: Ashwin was the first Indian international to join MLC — the US-based cricket league NRIs actually attend. His one-match exit is a setback for the league's Indian talent pipeline and Bay Area cricket fans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Five Losses in a Row. England Seal Their First-Ever T20 Series Win Over India.
articles.excerpt: Harry Brook's 79 off 35 balls and Phil Salt's unbeaten 59 power England to a nine-wicket win at Bristol. Shreyas Iyer's lone 80 not out cannot save India from a record-extending collapse.
articles.image_caption: Harry Brook in action for England
articles.nri_angle: India's record five-match T20 losing streak and the omission of World Cup hero Sanju Samson are dominating NRI cricket debates from the Bay Area to the Tri-State area.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dada Enters the Pantheon. Sourav Ganguly Inducted Into ICC Hall of Fame.
articles.excerpt: The former India captain becomes the 10th Indian men's cricketer in cricket's most exclusive club. Sachin Tendulkar's tribute: 'This wasn't a surprise.' A Rajkummar Rao biopic was unveiled the same day.
articles.image_caption: Sourav Ganguly, former India captain and newly inducted ICC Hall of Fame member
articles.nri_angle: Ganguly's fearless captaincy defined how a generation of NRIs see Indian cricket — his Lord's celebration and refusal to back down became symbols of a new Indian confidence that resonated far beyond the boundary.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mbappe's Eighth Goal Sends France Past Morocco and Into the World Cup Semifinals.
articles.excerpt: Kylian Mbappe and Ousmane Dembele score in the second half as France eliminate Morocco 2-0 in Foxborough. Les Bleus await the winner of Spain vs. Belgium in the last four.
articles.image_caption: France celebrate their quarterfinal victory at the 2026 FIFA World Cup
articles.nri_angle: With all quarterfinals and semifinals on American soil and in American time zones, NRI watch parties from Edison to Fremont are turning this World Cup into the most accessible global football event in diaspora history.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: 212 Years of Lord's. Zero Women's Tests. Until Friday.
articles.excerpt: England and India will play the first-ever women's Test at the Home of Cricket, 50 years after Rachael Heyhoe-Flint led the first women's match at the ground.
articles.image_caption: Lord's Cricket Ground in London, set to host its first women's Test match in its 212-year history (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.nri_angle: The first women's Test at Lord's gives NRIs in the UK a historic chance to watch India's women at cricket's most iconic venue, correcting a 212-year exclusion.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cricket's Mr. 360 Goes to Baseball. Suryakumar Yadav Named MLB's First Indian Ambassador.
articles.excerpt: India's T20 World Cup-winning captain will attend All-Star Week in Philadelphia, as Major League Baseball bets big on the world's largest cricket-loving market.
articles.image_caption: Suryakumar Yadav, India's T20 World Cup-winning captain, named MLB's newest global ambassador
articles.nri_angle: India's cricket captain bridging the gap between cricket and baseball gives NRIs in America official representation at the highest level of both bat-and-ball sports.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: America's Cricket League Has a Runaway Leader. San Francisco's Unicorns Are the Team to Beat.
articles.excerpt: With five wins from eight matches and a four-point cushion at the top, the Unicorns are turning Major League Cricket's fourth season into a one-horse race.
articles.image_caption: Cricket action at a Major League Cricket venue in the United States
articles.nri_angle: MLC is the only major cricket league NRIs in the US can attend in person and watch in their own time zone, making it uniquely accessible for diaspora fans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Eight Teams. Four Cities. Three Days. The World Cup Quarterfinals Are Here.
articles.excerpt: France face Morocco in a semifinal rematch today in Boston, while Spain, Argentina, England, Belgium, Norway, and Switzerland battle for semifinal spots across three host cities through Saturday.
articles.image_caption: France's Kylian Mbappé during their Round of 16 match against Paraguay at Philadelphia Stadium
articles.nri_angle: All quarterfinal matches are being played in US cities with large Indian-origin communities, from Boston to Los Angeles to Miami to Kansas City — this World Cup is in the diaspora's backyard.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Series Lost. Pride on the Line. India's Last Stand Against England Begins in Bristol.
articles.excerpt: India trail 0-2 after the humiliating 76 all out at Trent Bridge. The fourth T20I at Bristol's County Ground today is a must-win to keep the series alive — and the Sanju Samson debate rages on.
articles.image_caption: India captain Shreyas Iyer faces mounting pressure after three consecutive T20I defeats on the UK tour
articles.nri_angle: For the large Indian diaspora in Britain and NRIs across the US, this painful tour — 0-2 down with the world number one T20I ranking at stake — has been must-watch despite the heartbreak.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Messi in Tears After Argentina's Three-Goal Comeback Stuns Egypt in 13 Frantic Minutes
articles.excerpt: Trailing 2-0 with 11 minutes left, the defending champions score three — Romero, Messi, Fernandez in stoppage time — to survive the round of 16 and reach the World Cup quarterfinals
articles.image_caption: Lionel Messi celebrates after scoring Argentina's equaliser against Egypt in Atlanta
articles.nri_angle: The World Cup quarterfinals are being played across US cities — LA, Miami, Kansas City, Foxborough — bringing the drama to NRI doorsteps
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Seventy-Six All Out. Archer and Tongue Rip Through India for England's Biggest-Ever T20 Win.
articles.excerpt: World champions bowled out in 11.4 overs — their lowest total in 18 years and heaviest defeat in T20I history — as England seize a 2-0 series lead with two to play
articles.image_caption: Jofra Archer, who took 3-29 to dismantle India's top order at Trent Bridge
articles.nri_angle: India's humiliating T20I defeat raises concern among diaspora cricket fans, especially as England threaten to overtake India's No. 1 T20I ranking
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
